run.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the EXACT GAME CHARACTER in the attached reference into successive action poses. The input has 5 direction ROWS; left column is original idle, right column is original walk. Treat it as a locked model sheet, not inspiration. Preserve exact original visual identity and FULL BODY proportions: same head-to-body ratio, neck/scarf position, torso LENGTH, trouser and boot LENGTH, shoulder width, warm muted colors, outline thickness, flat cel shading with subtle small highlights. Do NOT make the character shorter, rounder, cuter, more childlike, more detailed or more chibi. The previous attempt failed because it compressed the body while matching the head. Match the reference standing height and head width simultaneously. Keep hair masses and facial features as close to the source pixels as possible. Plain cream hands, no gloves. Olive short sleeve tunic, cream sleeve cuffs, yellow scarf, brown belt with brass buckle, brown trousers, brown boots. No backpack or new details. Same lighting in EVERY FRAME. No fuzzy painted texture or added hair strand detail.
Create a regular sprite sheet with FIVE EXACTLY EQUAL HEIGHT ROWS and 8 EXACTLY EQUAL WIDTH COLUMNS. Every sprite fully contained in its cell, generous transparent gutters, all same scale/camera. No text labels, lines, floor, effects or shadow. Row 1 = pure SIDE facing RIGHT, only ONE eye visible, exactly like input row1. Row 2 = FRONT three-quarter facing DOWN-RIGHT like input row2. Row 3 = straight FRONT like input row3. Row 4 = BACK three-quarter facing UP-RIGHT like input row4 (face at RIGHT edge of head, not left). Row 5 = straight BACK like input row5, NO face. All columns in a row maintain identical direction, hair/head silhouette and scale. Columns sequentially animate the action. Keep all upright poses equally tall as original idle reference. All cells use exactly the same horizontal body axis and ground baseline. The same single character is reused, only joint poses differ.
ACTION: A complete eight-frame RUN cycle: 1 left foot forward contact right arm forward, 2 left support compression, 3 left toe push and right knee passing, 4 brief flight right leg forward, 5 right contact left arm forward, 6 right support compression, 7 right toe push left knee passing, 8 brief flight left leg forward back to frame1. Opposite arms and legs, consistent body anatomy, compact athletic strides, NOT wide splits. Head stays steady; feet follow a believable arc. Frames 1/5 are same body height as idle (grounded upright height).
